feature_definitions.has_any_prospective_evidence: true iff episode has at least one member BaselineObservationInput with is_prospective=true at as_of
feature_definitions.has_prospective_primary_emission: true iff at least one prospective member observation has signal role PRIMARY_EMISSION
feature_definitions.prospective_last_observed_at: maximum observed_at among prospective member observations; null when none
feature_definitions.prospective_age_seconds: integer whole seconds from prospective_last_observed_at to as_of; null when no prospective member
feature_definitions.prospective_source_role_diversity: count of distinct signal roles across prospective member observations only
feature_definitions.prospective_evidence_count: count of prospective member observations only
feature_definitions.baseline_activity_metrics: reuse control BaselineEpisode mentions_1h, mentions_6h, mentions_24h, velocity_6h_delta, acceleration_6h for the exact same current grouping episode

configuration.grouping_contract: candidate uses exact control grouping episode membership at each as_of and never regroups observations

allowed: prospective PRIMARY_EMISSION role presence derived only from prospectively eligible member observations
prospective last-observed freshness derived only from prospectively eligible member observations
baseline prospective activity windows: mentions_1h, mentions_6h, mentions_24h, velocity_6h_delta, acceleration_6h
prospective source-role diversity derived only from prospectively eligible member observations
episode_id only as final deterministic tie-breaker
prohibited: BACKFILL observations as live activity or freshness
recovered-after-gap observations as live activity or freshness
raw payload, title, URL, body text, embedding or semantic-text features
source-specific identity as a ranking feature
future observations, future health, future grouping, evaluation labels or outcome data
confirmation, provenance-root, entity, assertion-lifecycle or manipulation verdict features
LLM outputs, remote mutable model outputs, learned weights or post-preregistration coefficient tuning
binary floating point or nondeterministic unseeded ranking

snapshot_schedule.start: first UTC epoch-multiple-of-300 boundary strictly after the GitHub main merge commit committer timestamp of the durable candidate-freeze receipt

opportunity.anchor: prospectively eligible canonical PRIMARY_EMISSION observation from one frozen V0 anchor source whose observed_at is inside the ranking window
opportunity.deduplication: at resolution_at, retain anchor only when it is earliest qualifying V0 primary-emission observation in its resolution grouping episode ordered by observed_at then observation_id
opportunity.mixed_domain_rule: if the resolution grouping episode contains qualifying V0 primary-emission anchors from more than one frozen stratum, classify UNQUALIFIED_MIXED

outcome_label.name: FOLLOW_ON_ATTENTION_OR_DISCOVERY_WITHIN_24H
outcome_label.positive: resolution grouping episode contains at least one prospectively eligible observation with anchor.observed_at < observed_at <= resolution_at from hn.frontpage with ATTENTION role or gdelt.frontier with DISCOVERY role
outcome_label.negative: no positive observation exists and both outcome lanes have OK transport/freshness/completeness/schema at every expected paired boundary from first boundary after anchor.observed_at through resolution_at
outcome_label.unresolved_coverage: absence cannot resolve negative when either outcome lane has non-OK or missing health at any required boundary

detection.episode_tracking: at each paired snapshot, locate the current grouping episode containing the stable anchor observation_id; episode_id may change as membership evolves
detection.candidate_detection: earliest paired boundary at or before resolution_at where current anchor episode candidate rank <= global K
detection.control_detection: earliest paired boundary at or before resolution_at where current anchor episode baseline rank <= global K

precision.arm_surfaced: opportunity detected at least once by that arm before or at resolution_at
precision.value: positive surfaced resolved opportunities / all surfaced resolved positive-or-negative opportunities
precision.point_floor: candidate_precision >= control_precision in every adequately sampled domain
precision.uncertainty_rule: Newcombe two-sided 95% score interval for independent proportions; lower bound of candidate-minus-control difference must be >= -0.10 in every adequately sampled domain

lead_time.population: all positive resolved retained opportunities in each adequately sampled domain, including arm misses assigned resolution_at

sample_adequacy.underpowered_domain: NOT_QUALIFYING; retained and reported; cannot be selected as a promotion domain
sample_adequacy.resolved_label_fraction_denominator: all retained non-duplicate non-UNQUALIFIED_MIXED opportunities in the domain
sample_adequacy.resolved_label_fraction_numerator: retained opportunities resolved POSITIVE or NEGATIVE; UNRESOLVED_COVERAGE is not resolved
